fit_score.instructions: How well does this place suit this diner overall? Weigh the stated preferences, benefits and drawbacks. Use only the supplied facts. Judge fit, not certainty about the facts.
criteria: Poor match: major conflicts with the diner's preferences and little appeal.
Weak match: drawbacks outweigh the appealing features.
Mixed match: meaningful appealing features and meaningful drawbacks balance out.
Good match: appealing features outweigh the drawbacks, with some compromise.
Perfect match: fits all stated preferences very well with no material drawback.

encoding.state: json.dumps(state, ensure_ascii=False), default separators, diner then place
encoding.request: json.dumps(request, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8"); model, state, questions in that order

labels: Model-written construction labels, not human ground truth or measured diner satisfaction. labels.json is copied whole, including labels and matched pairs outside the selected 40 cases.
input_policy: Retain hard-limit text only in this historical lane. This is not a production soft-state builder. No label certifies inputs modified to remove hard fields.
